description: This file defines an internal sealed class 'CachingIdSpanCodec' responsible for serializing and deserializing IdSpan objects with caching mechanisms to improve performance and reduce redundant encoding. It manages an internal cache, periodically purges stale entries, and interacts with a shared cache to minimize duplicates.

classes.name: CachingIdSpanCodec
classes.description: A serializer for IdSpan objects that caches values to avoid re-encoding and reduce allocations. Implements cache management, including periodic cleanup of stale entries, and interacts with a shared cache to minimize duplicates.

methods.name: ReadRaw
methods.description: Deserializes an IdSpan from the reader, utilizing internal and shared caches to optimize repeated values.

methods.name: WriteRaw
methods.description: Serializes an IdSpan to the writer and caches it in the shared cache to minimize duplication.

methods.name: PurgeStaleEntries
methods.description: Removes stale cache entries that haven't been accessed within a specified timeout period.
